subject: Request: one-time overnight throughput voucher + trial extension for POC run
messages:
From: Elena Morales <elena@novacart.io>
To: jonas_weber@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 10 Apr 2028 23:12:00 +0000
Subject: Nightly run ask — 12h stress window and trial extension?

Hi Jonas,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — the latency profile looks promising for our edge use case. We have a 12-hour overnight soak planned to validate 99th percentile tail latency and cold-start behavior for our parallel callers. Our trial credits will exhaust before we finish the run.

Can Redwood provide a one-time throughput voucher (~40k token-equivalent) and a 48-hour trial extension so we can finish the night soak? We’ll run from 02:00–14:00 UTC on Thu (two days from now). Plan attached (poc-load-plan.pdf).

Key asks:
- Voucher size: ~40k token-equivalent or equivalent run budget
- Trial extension: 48 hours
- Confirm whether KV-prefix caching will persist across the soak (we expect multiple warmup phases)

If you need an internal PO or SOW, send it and we’ll expedite.

Best,
Elena
Director of Platform
Novacart
From: jonas_weber@redwood.ai
To: Elena Morales <elena@novacart.io>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, ben_carter@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 10 Apr 2028 23:45:00 +0000
Subject: RE: Nightly run ask — 12h stress window and trial extension?

Elena — thanks for the clear runbook and timeline. I’ve looped in Marissa (sales ops) and Ben (partner ops) to clear a one-time voucher and any compliance checks.

Quick answers while they jump in:
- We can provision a one-off promotional voucher for POCs; size subject to approvals (I requested 40k tokens).
- 48-hour extension is typically straightforward for trial accounts tied to active POCs; I asked Marissa to approve it by EOD tomorrow.
- KV/prefix caching: our platform keeps KV cache within the same endpoint VM cluster for the session; long warmups that span VM reboots may lose caches. Ben — can you flag whether this run (12h) should be opened on a dedicated pool to reduce cache churn?

Elena — I’ll confirm final numbers and post the voucher + extension window once Marissa approves. Can you confirm the exact UTC start time and the expected peak QPS and batch size? That’ll help sizing the voucher.

Thanks,
Jonas
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
From: marissa_cole@redwood.ai
To: jonas_weber@redwood.ai, ben_carter@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 11 Apr 2028 09:10:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Nightly run ask — 12h stress window and trial extension?

Jonas / Ben — giving provisional approval for a one-time promotional voucher and a 48-hour extension for Novacart’s POC. Details below: 

- Voucher: 42,000 token-equivalent credit (CSV voucher attached: throughput-voucher.csv)
- Trial extension: +48 hours starting at the original trial expiry; I’ve extended the account in the console and noted the extension against deal NB-2028-0410-PTC.
- Conditions: voucher valid for the specified run window only (02:00–14:00 UTC on 2028-04-13). Any additional runs will require a quick follow-up.
- Ops note: Ben — please pin Novacart onto the preprod-dedicated-small pool for that 12h window to stabilize KV caching and avoid noisy neighbors. Also enable higher telemetry retention for 7 days so the engineering team can analyze tail latencies.

Attachments: throughput-voucher.csv (voucher code + token-equivalent), internal checklist (referenced in linked drive).

Jonas — once Ben confirms pool pinning and we record the voucher code to HubSpot, you can send Elena the voucher and the confirmation.

Marissa Cole
Sales Operations, Redwood Inference
From: ben_carter@redwood.ai
To: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, jonas_weber@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 11 Apr 2028 09:42:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Nightly run ask — 12h stress window and trial extension?

All — I’ve scheduled a preprod-dedicated-small reservation for Novacart for 2028-04-13 02:00–14:00 UTC. Pinning is in place and KV persistence windows are extended for that cluster for the run. Telemetry retention increased to 7 days; I also activated extra token-level tracing for the 12-hour window so we can capture tail events.

Next steps: Jonas — share the voucher code and a short checklist with Elena (warmup plan + who to ping if we see p95/p99 spikes). I’ll monitor during the run and be on-call.

Ben Carter
Partner Operations, Redwood Inference
From: jonas_weber@redwood.ai
To: Elena Morales <elena@novacart.io>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, ben_carter@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 12 Apr 2028 09:03:00 +0000
Subject: Approved: voucher + extension for Novacart overnight soak (details)

Elena — good news: we approved the one-time voucher and extended your trial. Details below and the voucher file is attached to this thread.

Voucher code: NOVA-POC-42K-APR13
Token-equivalent: 42,000
Extension: +48 hours applied to your trial account; runs allowed only for the 02:00–14:00 UTC slot on 2028-04-13.
Pinned pool: preprod-dedicated-small (KV persistence enabled)
Telemetry: 7-day retention + token-level tracing enabled during the window

Checklist for tonight’s run:
- Start warmup at 01:30 UTC with ramped callers (low QPS)
- Ramp to peak at 02:00 UTC (target peak: 850 QPS, batch size 8)
- Observe p95/p99 and drop QPS by 20% if p99 exceeds 850ms for >1 minute
- Ping ben_carter@redwood.ai immediately for any infra anomalies

If you’re good with the checklist we’ll mark the voucher as delivered in HubSpot and standby for the run.

Thanks and good luck — please send any logs or traces you want us to include in the postmortem.

Jonas
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
